faqs.question: Is there a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible new Cloud accounts get one {durationDays}-day free trial of most of the product, with no card required. It includes {maxMonitors} monitors checked at most every {minCheckIntervalMinutes} minutes, {maxStatusPages} status pages with up to {maxStatusPageSubscribers} subscribers each, {playwrightMinutes} browser minutes in total for Playwright tests and synthetic monitors, k6 load tests of up to {k6MaxVus} virtual users per run ({k6VuMinutes} virtual-user minutes in total), {sreInvestigations} AI SRE investigations, {triageRuns} AI triage runs, {aiCredits} AI credits, and {maxTeamMembers} team members and {maxProjects} projects. Custom domains, AI SRE chat and evidence briefs are available on paid plans only. You can also try the live demo at demo.supercheck.dev without signing up. Choose Plus or Pro at any time to lift the limits.

faqs.question: What tests can I run during the trial?
faqs.answer: You can run Playwright, API, and k6 load tests against public targets without registering a domain or setting up DNS verification. k6 tests can use up to {k6MaxVus} virtual users per run and {k6VuMinutes} virtual-user minutes across the whole trial. Each run is reserved at {k6MaxVus} virtual users, so it can last as long as your remaining minutes cover at that size, and it stops when they run out.

faqs.question: What happens when the free trial ends?
faqs.answer: Your monitors are paused and your status pages are archived, so nothing keeps running without a plan. Nothing is deleted: your tests, jobs, monitors, status pages, and history are kept, and normal data retention still applies to old results and artifacts. You can still sign in and look at your data, but you cannot create, run, or publish anything until you subscribe. When you subscribe to Plus or Pro, paused monitors resume and archived status pages are republished automatically.
